results.source: Voice in: Claude Code's built-in /voice mode (see Tooling Index) — free, no API key needed, just a Claude.ai login and a mic. Voice out (British "Jarvis" voice): Fish Audio's Voice Library has a ready "Butler"/British voice, no cloning needed (or clone your own from 10+ seconds of clean audio — never clone a real celebrity's voice, likeness/IP risk). Emotion tags on the S2.1 model ([calm], [amused]) control delivery in-line. Wire it reliably with a short script that POSTs your agent's reply text to Fish Audio's TTS API and plays back the MP3 (a community MCP exists but defaults to older models).

results.source: Build the site — have Claude Code turn the cleaned, enriched dataset into the actual directory website (listings pages, lead-capture forms). Niche for defensible SEO — don't compete head-on with a broad category; carve a sub-niche with real search volume (validate via Ahrefs) but no entrenched SEO/backlink competition. Monetization menu: lead-gen (sell inbound leads to listed businesses, referral-fee model), display ads, a crowdsourced "data moat" model, or evolving into a vertical micro-SaaS layered on top of the directory. Reality check: this is a longer-horizon, compounding-traffic play — explicitly not a "make money in under 6 months" tactic; better framed as a vehicle to learn AI-coding + SEO + sales simultaneously.

results.source: Build the site — have Claude Code turn the cleaned, enriched dataset into the actual directory website (listings pages, lead-capture forms). Niche for defensible SEO — don't compete head-on with a broad category; carve a sub-niche with real search volume (validate via Ahrefs) but no entrenched SEO/backlink competition. Split the list into groups of ~3 cards each — small enough that a subagent's own context is very unlikely to hit compaction. Before touching the product, drive the same steps a second way — a scripted click, a direct check, a fresh run — and confirm the failure is still there. If it only fails under the model's eye, the finding is against the test, and the fix belongs in the feature file. Reproducing takes seconds, needs nobody, and is itself part of fixing; what it prevents is an agent confidently repairing something that was never broken.

results.source: Build the site — have Claude Code turn the cleaned, enriched dataset into the actual directory website (listings pages, lead-capture forms). Niche for defensible SEO — don't compete head-on with a broad category; carve a sub-niche with real search volume (validate via Ahrefs) but no entrenched SEO/backlink competition. Monetization menu: lead-gen (sell inbound leads to listed businesses, referral-fee model), display ads, a crowdsourced "data moat" model, or evolving into a vertical micro-SaaS layered on top of the directory. results.source: An agent's harness is the wiring that lets the model run code/commands, read/write files, call APIs/tools, remember across sessions, and run tests/checks — distinct from the model (the reasoner) and the "brain" (what it knows / is fed). Most people who use AI poorly have never built or tuned a harness; this is described as the actual differentiator. Create/open a project folder in your editor (Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, or any VS Code fork), or install the "Claude Code for VS Code" extension from the Extensions tab. Open the integrated terminal, type claude to start — this runs locally, giving Claude read/write/file/command access on your machine (not a hosted web app).

results.source: So: a failed assertion from a vision engine is a question until it reproduces deterministically. Before touching the product, drive the same steps a second way — a scripted click, a direct check, a fresh run — and confirm the failure is still there. If it only fails under the model's eye, the finding is against the test, and the fix belongs in the feature file. Reproducing takes seconds, needs nobody, and is itself part of fixing; what it prevents is an agent confidently repairing something that was never broken.

results.source: An agent's harness is the wiring that lets the model run code/commands, read/write files, call APIs/tools, remember across sessions, and run tests/checks — distinct from the model (the reasoner) and the "brain" (what it knows / is fed). Most people who use AI poorly have never built or tuned a harness; this is described as the actual differentiator. Create/open a project folder in your editor (Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, or any VS Code fork), or install the "Claude Code for VS Code" extension from the Extensions tab. Open the integrated terminal, type claude to start — this runs locally, giving Claude read/write/file/command access on your machine (not a hosted web app).

results.source: Build the site — have Claude Code turn the cleaned, enriched dataset into the actual directory website (listings pages, lead-capture forms). Niche for defensible SEO — don't compete head-on with a broad category; carve a sub-niche with real search volume (validate via Ahrefs) but no entrenched SEO/backlink competition. Monetization menu: lead-gen (sell inbound leads to listed businesses, referral-fee model), display ads, a crowdsourced "data moat" model, or evolving into a vertical micro-SaaS layered on top of the directory. Reality check: this is a longer-horizon, compounding-traffic play — explicitly not a "make money in under 6 months" tactic; better framed as a vehicle to learn AI-coding + SEO + sales simultaneously.

results.source: An agent's harness is the wiring that lets the model run code/commands, read/write files, call APIs/tools, remember across sessions, and run tests/checks — distinct from the model (the reasoner) and the "brain" (what it knows / is fed). Most people who use AI poorly have never built or tuned a harness; this is described as the actual differentiator. Create/open a project folder in your editor (Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, or any VS Code fork), or install the "Claude Code for VS Code" extension from the Extensions tab. Open the integrated terminal, type claude to start — this runs locally, giving Claude read/write/file/command access on your machine (not a hosted web app).
